newsitem.title: UK: CRICKET-ENGLAND WIN WITH A DAY TO SPARE.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-ENGLAND WIN WITH A DAY TO SPARE.

text.p: England crushed the Australians by nine wickets in the first test on Sunday.
The touring team, bowled out for just 118 on the opening day, had batted themselves back into contention with second innings centuries by captain Mark Taylor (129) and Greg Blewett (125).
But they slumped from 354 for two to 477 all out on the fourth day, setting a modest target of 118.
England reached it in 21.3 overs, with Taylor's opposite number Michael Atherton making an unbeaten 57 and Alec Stewart 39 not out.

It was only England's third victory over Australia in 23 attempts and the first time for five years that they had had won three successive tests, following two victories in New Zealand earlier this year.
